metadata.notes: Ranks 26-50 from vault scan. 16 papers had PDF extracts available; 9 papers had no vault entry or extract (scored from filenames/titles only, marked low confidence).

papers.filename: 2023-Astobiza-MoralNet.md

features.T1_primary_theory: multiple (virtue ethics, deontology, utilitarianism, moral psychology)

papers.scoring_notes: Conceptual proposal for MoralNet -- an ImageNet-style competition for moral benchmarking. No actual dataset or items yet; purely a proof-of-concept framework paper. Draws on virtue ethics, deontology, utilitarianism. 6-page NeurIPS workshop submission. No cultural specificity.

papers.filename: 2025-Chen-MoVa Towards Generalizable Classification of Human Morals and Values.md

features.T1_primary_theory: Moral Foundations Theory, Schwartz Human Values, Morality-as-Cooperation, Common Morality

papers.scoring_notes: MoVa: 16 labeled datasets across 4 moral/value frameworks (MFT, Schwartz, MAC, Common Morality). ~136K total instances. Key innovation: all-at-once prompting strategy outperforms fine-tuned models. 45 pages. Cross-framework generalization tested. English-only data but theoretically grounded in cross-cultural Schwartz values.

papers.filename: 2025-Zhou-Moral Reasoning Across Languages.md
papers.scoring_notes: MMRB: 2170 moral scenarios across 5 languages at 3 complexity levels (sentence/paragraph/document). Key finding: low-resource languages like Vietnamese disproportionately impact multilingual moral reasoning. Includes Vietnamese and Indonesian (Global South). Built on ETHICS dataset variants. 5 LLMs tested.

papers.filename: 2024-Yu-CMoralEval.md
papers.scoring_notes: CMoralEval: 30,388 instances across explicit moral scenarios (14,964) and moral dilemmas (15,424). 5-class taxonomy: familial, social, professional, internet, personal morality. Rooted in Chinese culture (TV program + newspaper anomies). Confucian + modern Chinese moral norms. ACL 2024. Chinese-only. Non-Western framework gap filled.

papers.filename: 2025-Ray-Incorporating indigenous knowledge systems into AI governance.md
papers.scoring_notes: Review paper comparing Maori Kaitiakitanga and Navajo Hozhoo for AI governance. Not a benchmark -- purely theoretical/governance framework. 16 pages. Argues IKS integration prevents 'contextual failure' in AI projects. Strong indigenous focus. No quantitative data or LLM evaluation.

papers.filename: 2025-Wang-GIVE Cultural Values and Biases in Visual Evaluations by AI Models.md
papers.scoring_notes: No vault entry or PDF extract found. Scored from title only: GIVE appears to be a cultural values benchmark for visual evaluations by AI models. Likely multimodal. Details undeterminable.

papers.filename: 2025-Xie-Do Language Models Capture Cultural Norms A Study of Acceptability.md
papers.scoring_notes: No vault entry or PDF extract found. Title suggests cultural norms acceptability study for LLMs. Likely probes whether LMs internalize cultural norms about acceptability. Details undeterminable.

papers.filename: 2026-Kabir-XCR-Bench A Multi-Task Benchmark for Evaluating Cultural Reasoning in.md

features.T1_primary_theory: Newmark CSI framework + Hall Triad of Culture

papers.scoring_notes: XCR-Bench: 4.9K parallel sentences + 1098 unique Culture-Specific Items spanning 3 reasoning tasks. Western (US/UK) source CSIs adapted to Chinese, Arabic, Bengali (including West Bengal vs Bangladesh variants). Integrates Newmark CSI framework with Hall Triad. Reveals ethno-religious biases within single languages. Global South included (Bangladesh, India, Arab countries).

papers.filename: 2024-Haemmerli-Morality In Pre-Trained Language Models.md
papers.scoring_notes: No vault entry or PDF extract found. Title suggests evaluation of morality encoded in pre-trained LMs. Likely related to Haemmerl et al. multilingual moral reasoning work. Details undeterminable.

papers.filename: 2025-Scherrer-MoralChoice.md
papers.scoring_notes: MoralChoice survey: 680 high-ambiguity + 687 low-ambiguity moral scenarios. 28 LLMs surveyed. Statistical methodology for eliciting beliefs (action likelihood, marginal action likelihood, QF-consistency). Vault has this as 2023-Scherrer. NeurIPS 2023. English-only. No cross-cultural dimension but strong methodology for probing moral beliefs.

papers.filename: 2025-Sun-CASE-Bench.md
papers.scoring_notes: CASE-Bench: Context-Aware Safety Benchmark using Contextual Integrity theory. Integrates context into safety assessments. ICML 2025. English-only. Not specifically cross-cultural. Key contribution is that current benchmarks miss context-dependent safety nuances.

papers.filename: 2025-Unknown-BenevolentLLM An Ethical Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs.md
papers.scoring_notes: No vault entry or PDF extract found. Title suggests ethical reasoning benchmark for LLMs. All features undeterminable beyond title inference.

papers.filename: 2026-Liu-JMedEthicBench.md
papers.scoring_notes: JMedEthicBench: 50K+ adversarial multi-turn conversations grounded in 67 JMA guidelines. First multi-turn medical safety benchmark for Japanese. 27 models evaluated. 7 jailbreak strategies discovered. Key finding: medical-specialized models exhibit INCREASED vulnerability. Non-English primary (Japanese). Cross-lingual evaluation included.

papers.filename: 2023-Tanmay-Probing the Moral Development of Large Language Models through Defining.md
papers.scoring_notes: Applies Kohlberg's DIT (Defining Issues Test) to 7 LLMs. 5 original DIT dilemmas + 4 novel ones (including culturally diverse: Rajesh vegetarian neighborhood dilemma). 12 ethical considerations per dilemma = 108 items total. GPT-4 achieves graduate-student P-score. Paper notes Kohlberg's Western bias. DIT purchased from U. Alabama.

papers.filename: 2024-Agarwal-Ethical Reasoning and Moral Value Alignment of LLMs Depend on the.md
papers.scoring_notes: Extends Rao et al. moral reasoning framework to 7 languages. Tests GPT-4, ChatGPT, Llama2-70B-Chat on ethical dilemmas with deontological/virtue/consequentialist policies. Key finding: GPT-4 most consistent; Hindi and Swahili show strongest bias. Includes Global South languages. LREC-COLING 2024. Foreign Language Effect on morality tested in LLMs.

papers.filename: 2024-Rao-NORMAD A Benchmark for Measuring the Cultural Adaptability of Large.md
papers.scoring_notes: NORMAD: 2.6K situational descriptions from 75 countries with hierarchical cultural context (ROT / Country+Value / Country). Key finding: LLMs fail to apply cultural knowledge (<60% in abstract settings vs >90% human). English-centric culture advantage. Best LLM <82% vs human >95% even with explicit norms. NAACL 2024. Highly relevant for cross-cultural alignment.

papers.filename: 2025-Arora-MASALA.md
papers.scoring_notes: No vault entry or PDF extract found. MASALA likely a South Asian cultural benchmark (name suggests Indian/South Asian focus). No data available to score features. Vault has 2023-Arora-Probing PLMs for Cross-Cultural Values which is related but different.

papers.filename: 2025-Han-Value Portrait.md

features.T1_primary_theory: Schwartz Theory of Basic Values + Big Five

papers.scoring_notes: Value Portrait: 520 query-response pairs from real LLM interactions, psychometrically validated against PVQ-21 (Schwartz) and BFI-10. 46 human subjects rated items; correlation-based validation. 44 LLMs evaluated. ACL 2025. Finds models prioritize Benevolence/Security/Self-Direction. Reveals demographic biases (gender, political). Ecologically valid (real interactions). Created in South Korea but English-only.

papers.filename: 2025-Li-LiveSecBench - A Dynamic Event-Driven Safety Benchmark for Chinese.md
papers.scoring_notes: LiveSecBench: Dynamic, continuously updated safety benchmark for Chinese LLMs. 5 dimensions: Public Safety, Fairness&Bias, Privacy, Truthfulness, Mental Health Safety. ELO rating system. 57 LLMs evaluated. Chinese-only. Safety-focused rather than values/moral alignment. Periodically updated to prevent contamination.

papers.filename: 2025-Wang-Values in Design How GPT Evaluates Public AI Principles.md
papers.scoring_notes: No vault entry or PDF extract found. Title suggests study of how GPT evaluates public AI principles -- likely values-in-design analysis rather than a benchmark. All features undeterminable.

papers.filename: 2026-Madhusudan-Common to Whom Regional Cultural Commonsense.md

features.T1_primary_theory: Outline of Cultural Materials (OCM anthropological taxonomy)

papers.scoring_notes: INDICA: 515 questions x 5 Indian regions = 1630 region-specific QA pairs across 8 everyday-life domains. OCM-grounded. Only 39.4% questions get pan-India agreement. LLMs achieve 13-21% accuracy on region-specific Qs. Strong geographic bias toward Central/North India. Generalizable methodology for any culturally heterogeneous nation. IRB-approved, Prolific recruitment.

papers.filename: 2024-Haemmerli-Morality In Pre-Trained Language Models An Empirical.md
papers.scoring_notes: No vault entry or PDF extract found. Appears to be the empirical version of the Haemmerli morality in PLMs paper. Zhou (2025) cites Haemmerl et al. (2023) as training monolingual Sentence-BERT models for 5 languages for multilingual moral reasoning. Details undeterminable without extract.

papers.filename: 2025-Guan-ValueScope Unveiling Implicit Norms and Values via Return Potential.md
papers.scoring_notes: No vault entry or PDF extract found. Title suggests use of Return Potential Model (sociology) to unveil implicit norms and values. Likely novel theoretical approach. All features undeterminable.

papers.filename: 2025-Palta-Speaking the Right Language.md
papers.scoring_notes: NOT a values/moral benchmark. Studies expertise alignment between users and LLM (Bing Copilot). 25K conversations analyzed. Finds expertise misalignment hurts user experience. No moral/ethical/cultural content. Low relevance for cross-cultural values alignment.

papers.filename: 2025-Simhi-ManagerBench Evaluating Safety-Pragmatism Trade-off in Managerial.md
papers.scoring_notes: ManagerBench: 2,440 scenarios testing safety-pragmatism tradeoff in LLM agents. 11 domains, 4 harm types, parallel human-harm vs inanimate-object control sets. 25 human validators. Key finding: frontier LLMs (GPT-4o 61%, Sonnet-4 23%) fail to balance operational goals with human safety. Misalignment is prioritization failure, not perception failure. No cross-cultural dimension.
